ambiguity.evidence: change.md Scope fixes the outcome (ADR-013 D1-D12), but research.md Open Questions 1-12 leave the seam, verdict format, archive path and state location open.

novelty.evidence: research.md section 4: a second chain on the shared router has no precedent in the repo; the engine is reusable, the decision core is not.

coupling.evidence: research.md section 4: paths(), decide(), attachResult(), compare locateSide and the override file are shared by all 10x callers; the stable surface in prd.md:122 must not break.

discovery.evidence: research.md section 4 maps the 10x literals (context/changes, context/archive) in route.mjs and the scripts/ modules; some sites, such as the init ignore probe and helpers.mjs, were found only by inference.

volume.evidence: change.md Scope: new chain switch across router modules, skills/openspec-pipeline/, four steps, policy keys, prompts, a new test helper, ADR-013 and docs; well over 10 files.

verification.evidence: change.md 'To be researched' items 1-4 are unverified live checks; research.md Open Questions 6-7 need a live probe of unattended OpenSpec skills; no harness exists for the OpenSpec CLI or verify verdict.
